name: Intraday-Close Momentum TQQQ
tagline: A volatility-targeted TQQQ core that steps to cash for 24 hours after a negative full-day QQQ close in an already-elevated volatility regime.
summary: Holds TQQQ at min(1, 0.20 / 10-day realised vol), and when QQQ's full 09:30-to-15:29 return is negative with vol at or above 20% it exits to cash for the next 24 hours. Dev 2016-2023 earns 46.21% CAGR / 53.87% max drawdown / 1.08 Sharpe at 1 bp and still clears the bar at 10 bp, but a vol-only control earns 44.09% and the close overlay adds only 2.1 pp of CAGR.
caveat: The holdout is effectively flat cash after 2023, and in dev the close overlay is statistically indistinguishable from random high-vol exits (placebo p = 0.22) and whipsawed -30% in January 2016, so the vol-targeted TQQQ core rather than the close signal is doing the work.
